Name: Xtardew Valley Anime Portrait
Author: PIG0227
Description:
[b]The mod glorifies portraits from events in the Xtardew Valley.
Xtardwe Valley:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4399]Xtardew Valley at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url]

The mod is based on an anime portrait created by Oho Davi. Thank you OhoDavi for the authorization.
StardewValley Anime Mods:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]stardewvalley anime mods at Stardew Valley Nexus - Mods and community (nexusmods.com)[/url][/b]

[size=4][b]How to Instal:[/b][/size]
Overwrite the Xtardew Portraits & Sprites in the Xtardew Valley Anime Portrait folder to the Xtardew Valley folder.

Xtardew Valley Anime Portrait\Xtardew Portraits&Sprites
   ---->   
Xtardew Valley\Xtardew Portraits&Sprites

[size=4][b][u]NOTE:[/u][/b][/size]
[size=3]1.[/size]For SVE, Anime portraits of Olivia and Sophia are now added,and added anime portraits of witches.

[size=3]2.[/size]The mod only modifies the portraits from the Xtardew Valley event, and all two different styles of portraits will appear if StardewValley Anime Mods is not installed.

[size=3]3.[/size]This description has been translated into English by Chinese and may not be expressed accurately, if there is any error, please correct it in the comments, thank you! :D
